name: Grapefruit Romulan Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Grapefruit Romulan is a descendant of the popular strains Romulan and Grapefruit. This strain, not surprisingly, has a strong grapefruit aroma and flavor. The high is calming and focused, with a mood boost, increased sociability, and physical relaxation.
